title: saml-connector-setup-concierge-metadata-sanity-and-operator-checklist
creator: Priya Patel
description: Create a self-contained 'onboarding concierge' flow for SAML 2.0 connector setup that performs automated metadata exchange, sanity checks, and operator-facing validation hints. This ticket covers: (1) round-trip metadata ingestion and verification (entityID, ACS endpoints, certs, bindings), (2) automated assertion simulation to catch common misconfigurations (clock skew, cert fingerprint mismatch, HTTP-POST/Redirect binding mismatches), (3) administrative RBAC v2 role mapping validation to ensure automated role syncs do not escalate privileges, and (4) audit log schema additions to surface SSO events and metadata diffs. The feature should provide clear remediation steps, a deterministic pass/fail matrix for metadata checks, and hooks for manual override with audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding concierge saves a validated metadata bundle and marks connector state as 'validated' on success
Automated assertion simulator produces a human-readable failure report with remediation hints for at least 8 common misconfigurations
RBAC v2 mapping validator flags any mapping that would grant admin or tenant-owner roles and prevents auto-apply unless operator acknowledges explicit confirmation
Audit log entries for metadata ingest, validation results, and manual overrides are emitted with consistent fields (timestamp, connector_id, user_id, validation_status, failing_checks)
Console shows a 'validation timeline' with certificate expiry warnings and a one-click retry for metadata re-ingest
implementation_notes: Metadata validation runs incremental checks: XML schema, entityID canonicalization, certificate parsing, signature verification, endpoints reachable, and binding compatibility
Add an 'assertion dry-run' mode that uses signed JWTs and SAMLResponse templates to emulate IdP behavior; runs in ephemeral isolated environment
Integrate RBAC v2 role-mapper lint: treat mappings that include 'admin', 'owner', or wildcard namespaces as high-risk; require explicit approver and store approver in audit log
Audit log schema must include metadata_diff (hash), cert_fingerprint, validation_snapshot_url, and approver when manual override occurs
Expose retry and manual-verify actions via Console and API; all manual actions must create an immutable audit record
